title: single_game_v2_compact
description: Compact single-game output for LLM self-coaching, schema 2.1. Derived from contract v1.2; instrumentation and derivable fields are omitted. Null means 'not measured' - it is never replaced by a guessed number. Null policy per field: summary.acpl / summary.phases[*][0] are null when the phase had no measured move; flags[].rank is null when the engine did not measure the played-move rank; flags[].motif is omitted when the move has no tactical motif (a present motif is always a string); eval_before/eval_after are omitted outside the FIX-015 window (cp > 200 or class blunder/mistake) or when the evaluation was not measured. Unavailable PV for a blunder/mistake is published in pv_unavailable instead of being silently omitted. P0-7: every flagged move is either covered by a pattern (pstatus=matched, patterns present) or states why no pattern covers it (pstatus=unclassified, why present). The reason is a measured shape of the move, not a claimed mechanism.

username.description: Player whose side is analysed. Omitted for anonymous games / when unknown.

acpl.description: Mean centipawn loss. Null when no move was measured.

acc.description: Internal accuracy score 0-100 (see acc_method). Null when no move was measured.

acc_method.description: P1: how acc was computed. internal_cp_linear = mean(max(0, 100 - 0.15*cp_loss)); NOT Lichess accuracy.

phase_method.description: P0-3: which phase source the detectors used. 'mixed' means the moves came from caches with different phase methods.

flags.description: One entry per flagged move (blunder, mistake, inaccuracy), ordered by ply ascending.

best.description: SAN of the engine best move

rank.description: Played move rank among engine candidates; null when not measured (engine timeout). Never 0.

pstatus.description: P0-7: 'matched' = at least one pattern covers this ply (patterns present); 'unclassified' = no pattern covers it (why present).

why.description: P0-7: measured reason the detector is silent. 'evidence_gap' = no engine line/best move/rank. 'quiet_positional' = no capture, no check, not in check. 'forcing_move_unexplained' = check given or faced without a pattern. 'capture_unexplained' = capture below the B threshold. 'mechanism_not_identified' = explicit fallback. 'not_classified' = source payload predates P0-7. Never a claimed mechanism.

motif.description: Tactical motif tag, e.g. discovered_check_capture. Omitted when the move has no tactical motif; null is not used here.

eval_before.description: Engine eval (cp, side-to-move POV) before the move. Present only for cp > 200 or class blunder/mistake.

eval_after.description: Engine eval (cp, side-to-move POV) after the move. Present only for cp > 200 or class blunder/mistake.

patterns.description: Behavioural pattern ids whose evidence includes this ply (CAND-E). Present iff pstatus=matched.

mate_in.description: FIX-027: forced mate in N moves from the engine's best line. Positive = mate for the player, negative = mate against the player. Only emitted for blunders whose best line is mate; eval_cp stays null in that case.

patterns_meta.description: P0-8: mandatory. An empty `patterns` list always has a reason, and coverage proves every flag is accounted for.

unclassified.description: P0-7 discovery feed: critical moments no pattern explains, ordered by ply. Omitted when empty; when present it lists exactly the flags with pstatus=unclassified.

pv.description: Optional. Map ply (string) -> principal variation SAN moves, max 3. Only for flagged plies with measured engine lines. A ply absent here but present in pv_unavailable has no PV for the stated reason.

pv_unavailable.description: Optional. Map ply (string) -> reason why no PV exists for a blunder/mistake. Makes a data gap explicit (FIX-014).

clusters.description: Optional. Runs of >= 3 flagged moves on consecutive own moves (plies step by 2), i.e. a likely time-pressure / attention cluster (CAND-F).

fen_before.description: Optional. Map ply (string) -> FEN before the flagged move. Only for cp_loss > 100.

report.description: Optional short deterministic summary. Never truncated mid-structure. Capped at 900 chars to keep the compact budget.

phase.description: [acpl, flagged_count]; acpl is null when the phase had no measured moves.
